In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|12|the appearance of the [[lava meerkat]]}}</ref>, a [[lava meerkat]] was saved from being beheaded and eaten by a [[Unidentified Aqualish gang|gang]] of [[Aqualish]] by [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] in the former [[Nevarro Mandalorian covert|Mandalorian covert]] on [[Nevarro]]. The creature showed affection to Dune, who gave it [[Foodstuff|something]] to eat and assured it of its safety. Later, when [[New Republic]] officer [[Carson Teva]] offered the position of official Marshal of the New Republic to Dune, the meerkat was still hanging around Dune like a stray pet.<ref name="Chapter 12" />
